issue_title: [Bug] Race condition: next_id() may generate duplicate IDs under concurrent access

fix_summary.root_cause: The `next_id()` method calculated IDs based on an in-memory list without file locking, causing TOCTOU race conditions when multiple processes called `add()` concurrently.
fix_summary.solution: Added file-based locking using `fcntl.flock` to serialize access. Introduced `add_todo()` method in TodoStorage that performs load → next_id → save as an atomic operation protected by an exclusive file lock.

risks_limitations: File locking uses fcntl.flock which works on Unix/Linux but may have different behavior on Windows
Lock file (.lock suffix) may remain if process crashes during lock acquisition, but this is harmless as flock is advisory
